findings: At 07:00:02 UTC control identity resolves one interface; radio up=true, pending=false, disabled=false.
Pipe control_ready waits 30.016s without readiness; PTY control_ready waits 30s and observes daemon_unreachable.
Combined readiness wait is about 60 seconds before compatibility fallback at 07:01:02 UTC.
Earlier target 13 used native mode, then timed out waiting for status. Native capability is not universally absent.
No evidence proves the daemon was merely starting slowly. Missing socket, stale ownership and service failure cannot be distinguished from this archive.
changes: Withdraw the additional readiness stage; actual PONG capability handshake keeps its original 5-second deadline per transport.
This removes the demonstrated added preparation delay, not the unresolved daemon reachability root cause.
Add local attempt-duration statistics refreshed after >=30 active verification seconds, excluding setup/history/pause and incomplete cancelled attempts.
Reuse dangerAction red button styling for clear attempt history in both themes.
